EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM WHERE ACCOUNTID='1367897'

D360.CATCHUP_CUSTOMER_DIM WHERE ACCOUNTID='539222'
UNION ALL

D360.CATCHUP_CUSTOMER_DIM WHERE ACCOUNTID='5977321'
